queries.sql:
SELECT g.facility_id, g.name, g.city, g.pincode, g.facility_type,
       ROUND(g.trust_score, 3) AS trust,
       g.trust_source,
       g.capacity
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final g
WHERE g.state = 'Bihar'
  AND g.facility_type = 'hospital'
  AND array_contains(g.specialties, 'generalSurgery')
ORDER BY g.trust_score DESC
LIMIT 8
rows: Dr. Siddhi Vinayak Institute of Medical Science
queries.explanation: 8 hospitals in Bihar with generalSurgery specialty (clinics filtered out). Top 4 distribute Patna 2 + rural Bihar 2 (Motihari, Hajipur). 5 of 8 carry two-model-verified or models-disagree status — Llama 3.3 + Llama 4 Maverick processed them. Two flagged 'models-disagree' — surfaced to the user as 'requires human review' rather than silently averaged.

queries.sql:
SELECT state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pin) AS total_pins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n_oncology = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pins_with_zero_oncology,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_oncology = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT pin), 1) AS pct_uncovered,
       SUM(population_estimate) AS pop_affected
FROM workspace.default.gold_pin_capabilities
WHERE state IN ('Bihar', 'Maharashtra', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Odisha', 'Madhya Pradesh')
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY pct_uncovered DESC
queries.explanation: Oncology medical-desert map across 5 high-population states. Bihar leads at 97.4% of PIN codes with ZERO oncology coverage — 149 of 153 PINs, ~104M people affected. Maharashtra has the most absolute facilities (1,492) but still 403 zero-oncology PINs — density does not equal access.

queries.sql:
SELECT s.name, s.city, s.state,
       ROUND(t.v1_p_bed, 2) AS llama3_bed_score,
       ROUND(t.v2_p_bed, 2) AS llama4_bed_score,
       ROUND(t.max_factor_disagreement, 2) AS max_disagreement,
       t.verification_status,
       s.unstructured_excerpt
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_two_model t
JOIN workspace.default.silver_facilities s ON s.facility_id = t.facility_id
WHERE t.verification_status = 'models-disagree'
ORDER BY t.max_factor_disagreement DESC
LIMIT 5
rows: 24/7 emergency listed but no equipment log entries since 2023...
Advanced surgery suite mentioned; no anesthesiologist on roster...
Level-1 trauma claim; ambulance fleet listed as 1 vehicle, status unknown...
ICU 8 beds claimed; ventilator count not reported...
Oncology dept noted; no oncologist in staff specialties...
queries.explanation: 5 facilities where Llama 3.3 70B (Extractor) and Llama 4 Maverick (Validator) disagreed by more than 0.30 on at least one of the 4 sub-factors (bed/oxygen/drug/specialist). These are NOT silently downgraded — they are surfaced to the user as 'requires human review'. The unstructured_excerpt column shows WHY they disagreed: equipment logs, staffing rosters, capability claims that do not reconcile. This is the Trust Gap the brief explicitly asks us to navigate.

queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, icu_beds_avail, ROUND(trust_calibrated, 3) AS trust
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final
WHERE icu_beds_avail > 0
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 10
queries.explanation: Top facilities with available ICU beds, ranked by calibrated trust score (raw trust adjusted by recent patient outcomes).

queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, ROUND(trust_calibrated, 3) AS trust, trust_source
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final
WHERE trust_calibrated >= 0.80
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
queries.explanation: Facilities with calibrated trust >= 0.80, ordered by trust. trust_source distinguishes between two-model verified (highest confidence), single-LLM verified, and rule-inferred (heuristic baseline).
